## Redwood Trust, Inc. Commences Offer to Exchange up to 17,360,000 Shares of Common Stock for Shares of 12.00% Junior Series B Participating Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock


November 17, 2026 6:20am EST[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_285065a1586f86ab3d143a1f3e48b6d5/redwoodtrust/news/2026-11-17_Redwood_Trust_Inc_Commences_Offer_to_Exchange_up_392.pdf)


MILL VALLEY, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Redwood Trust, Inc. (NYSE: RWT; “Redwood”, “we”, “us” or the “Company”), a leader in expanding access to housing for homebuyers and renters, announced today the commencement of an offer to exchange up to 17,360,000 of the currently issued and outstanding shares of common stock of the Company, par value $0.01 per share (the “Common Stock”), for newly issued shares of the Company’s 12.00% Junior Series B Participating Cumulative Redeemable Preferred Stock, par value $0.01 per share and liquidation preference stated at $25.00 per share for purposes of determining dividends (the “Junior Series B Participating Preferred Stock”), with each 7.58 shares of Common Stock being exchangeable for 1 share of Junior Series B Participating Preferred Stock.


The exchange offer will expire at one minute after 11:59 P.M. (12:00 midnight), New York City time, on December 15, 2026 (the “Expiration Date”), unless extended or terminated.


“With today’s commencement of the exchange offer, we are providing existing common stockholders, particularly those who prioritize current income, with an alternative way to participate in the Company's future,” said Christopher Abate, Chief Executive Officer of Redwood. “This participating preferred stock will offer a dividend rate of 12%, coupled with participation, through its redemption and preference terms, in the performance of the Company’s common stock price following the exchange.”


The exchange offer is conditioned on, among other things, the valid tender (without valid withdrawal) of at least 8,680,000 shares of Common Stock prior to the Expiration Date.


The exchange offer is being made pursuant to an Offer to Exchange dated November 17, 2026 (“Offer to Exchange”) filed as an exhibit to the Company’s Schedule TO, dated November 17, 2026, each of which has been filed with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (the “SEC”) and more fully sets forth the terms and conditions of the exchange offer and the Junior Series B Participating Preferred Stock, including certain conditions to the closing of the exchange offer. The exchange offer is being made only to the current stockholders of the Company. The Company has retained Computershare Trust Company, N.A. as the exchange agent for the exchange offer and MacKenzie Partners, Inc. as the information agent.


Copies of the Offer to Exchange and the related Letter of Transmittal are being mailed to the Company’s stockholders. Additional copies of the Offer to Exchange and the related Letter of Transmittal may be obtained at the Company’s expense from the information agent at (800) 322-2885 (toll free) or[\[email protected\]](https://www.redwoodtrust.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#aefcf9fa83e3fee7eec3cfcdc5cbc0d4c7cbdecfdcdac0cbdcdd80cdc1c3) . Questions regarding the exchange offer should be directed to the information agent at (800) 322-2885 (toll free) or[\[email protected\]](https://www.redwoodtrust.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#a1f3f6f58cecf1e8e1ccc0c2cac4cfdbc8c4d1c0d3d5cfc4d3d28fc2cecc) . Parties outside the U.S. can reach the information agent at +1-(212) 929-5500 (toll collect) or[\[email protected\]](https://www.redwoodtrust.com/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#055752512848554c456864666e606b7f6c60756477716b6077762b666a68) .


**About the Company**


Redwood Trust, Inc. (NYSE: RWT) is a specialty finance company focused on several distinct areas of housing credit where we provide liquidity to growing segments of the U.S. housing market not well served by government programs. We deliver customized housing credit investments to a diverse mix of investors, through our best-in-class securitization platforms, whole-loan distribution activities, joint ventures and our publicly traded shares. We operate through three core residential housing-focused operating platforms — Sequoia, Aspire, and CoreVest — alongside our complementary Redwood Investments portfolio which is primarily composed of assets we source through these platforms. Redwood Investments also includes RWT Horizons®, our unified technology platform spanning internal AI innovation and strategic investments across the ecosystem, which supports our efforts to develop an AI-first operating model that enables compounding operational leverage and scalable growth. This reflects how we manage and organize our business and may differ from the manner in which our reportable segments are presented for financial reporting purposes.


Our goal is to provide attractive returns to shareholders through earnings and dividends, capital appreciation, and a commitment to technological innovation that facilitates risk-minded scale. Redwood Trust is internally managed and is currently structured as a real estate investment trust (“REIT”) for tax purposes. The Company has announced a plan to transition to a C-corporation beginning with its 2027 tax year. For more information about Redwood, please visit our website at[www.redwoodtrust.com](https://www.redwoodtrust.com/) or connect with us on LinkedIn.

The exchange offer is being made only pursuant to the Offer to Exchange and the related materials that Redwood Trust, Inc. is distributing to its stockholders, as they may be amended or supplemented. None of the Company, any of its management or its board of directors, the exchange agent or the information agent makes any recommendation as to whether or not holders of the Company’s Common Stock should participate in this exchange offer.


The Company is relying on Section 3(a)(9) of the Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the “Securities Act”), to exempt the exchange offer from the registration requirements of the Securities Act. Section 3(a)(9) provides that the registration requirements of the Securities Act will not apply to “any security exchanged by the issuer with its existing security holders exclusively where no commission or other remuneration is paid or given directly or indirectly for soliciting such exchange.” The Company has no current or planned contract, arrangement or understanding relating to, and will not, directly or indirectly, pay any commission or other remuneration to any broker, dealer, salesperson, agent or any other person for soliciting tenders in the exchange offer.
